thread.title: Here are all the new Animoji coming to your iPhone X (AAPL)

author: Avery Hartmans
title: Here are all the new Animoji coming to your iPhone X (AAPL)
text:
Apple's head of marketing, Phil Schiller, unveiled Animojis at an Apple event in September. Justin Sullivan/Getty Apple unveiled its next iPhone software, iOS 11.3, on Wednesday. The update, set to arrive this spring, includes four new Animojis: lion, dragon, skull, and bear. The new Animojis are available only on iPhone X. 
New Animojis are coming to the iPhone X. 
On Wednesday, Apple unveiled a few features of iOS 11.3, its new software for iPhones and iPads that is set to arrive sometime this spring. The update includes new augmented-reality capabilities, more information about your phone's battery, a new health records feature, and four new Animojis. 
Animojis, which are available only on the iPhone X, are animated emojis that can mimic your facial expressions thanks to the sensors and front-facing camera on Apple's latest iPhone. Apple included a slew of Animojis when the iPhone X launched — including a cat, a dog, a chicken, and a pig — but this is its first time announcing new options since the phone was unveiled in September.
